text: [214] pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā bahubhāṇismiṃ puggale katame pañca musā bhaṇati pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati pharusaṃ bhaṇati samphappalāpaṃ bhaṇati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā bahubhāṇismiṃ puggale . pañcime bhikkhave ānisaṃsā mantabhāṇismiṃ 1 puggale katame pañca na musā bhaṇati na pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati na pharusaṃ bhaṇati na samphappalāpaṃ bhaṇati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā mantabhāṇismiṃ puggaleti .
